Strategy: Save room for a double-size item. A leftover that still fits an item twice this size stays valuable for big arrivals, while one just below that threshold is far less useful. Score bins by leftover with a bonus at twice the item size, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin preserving double-size room. Exact fits rank top. It may help by keeping big-item capacity, but may fail by wasting loose bins when big items never come.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if r - item >= item * 2 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Double-size usability bonus: +item when post-placement leftover >= 2*item.
